scenario1.description: Multi-line notes and long exercise names (>60 chars)
scenario1.notes: Long exercise names (>60 chars) and multi-line notes are handled properly with wrapText: true when DOM removeChild does not fail.

scenario2.description: Undefined or missing specs fields (sets, reps, load, rest, rpe, tempo)
scenario2.notes: safeVal fallback catches undefined/null/empty strings and converts to 'N/A' preventing 'undefined' text in cells.

scenario3.description: 5+ phases and long phase names (>31 chars)
scenario3.collidingPhasesError: Worksheet name already exists: Fase 1- Programma Clinico Avanz
scenario3.findings: CRITICAL: Truncating phase names to 31 chars without disambiguation causes ExcelJS duplicate worksheet name error ('Worksheet name already exists'), crashing the entire export.

scenario4.notes: Rest days rendered with merged cells A:K and emerald header background.

scenario5.findings: OMISSION ISSUE: When ex.note is undefined, adaptationReason and adaptedFrom are NOT rendered in 'Note Coach' column (shows 'N/A'), losing crucial clinical rationale.
